_readme: Each published collection renders one section on its category's collection page, in `order`. Unlimited collections are supported; the filter row and counts are derived from this file plus designs.json.

collections.name: Hand-knotted
collections.title: Hand-
collections.subtitle: Knot by knot on the loom.
collections.intro: The finest definition we can offer, and the construction that carries painterly artwork best. Knot count, yarn and dye lot are set per design.
collections.note: {n} designs shown. Every one is woven to order — re-coloured, re-scaled and re-proportioned for the project. New designs are added as the studio develops them.

collections.name: Hand-tufted
collections.title: Hand-
collections.subtitle: Texture, carving and pile height.
collections.intro: Carved outlines, loop-and-cut surfaces and high-low relief, at a shorter lead time than knotting.
collections.note: {n} designs shown. Every one is woven to order — re-coloured, re-scaled and re-proportioned for the project. New designs are added as the studio develops them.

collections.name: Flatweave
collections.title: Flat
collections.subtitle: Woven flat, low underfoot.
collections.intro: Graphic and geometric work, layering, and rooms where a pile would sit too high.
collections.note: {n} designs shown. Every one is woven to order — re-coloured, re-scaled and re-proportioned for the project. New designs are added as the studio develops them.

collections.name: Other techniques
collections.title: Other
collections.subtitle: Constructions we develop beyond the three main ones.
collections.intro: Printed, braided, soumak, loop-and-cut and mixed constructions — developed where a design or an application calls for them. Availability depends on the design, the size and the workshop, so these are shown as work rather than as a standing range.
collections.note: {n} designs shown, and the group grows as new techniques are developed. Every one is woven to order — re-coloured, re-scaled and re-proportioned for the project.
